text: Alex K: Mocked up a new approach for the notification panel — thinking accordion per-channel instead of tabs. Keeps everything on the page for quick skim. Maya R: I like accordion for scanability. Question: how do we surface the "Test notification" action without making each panel too heavy? Alex K: Proposed: compact header with channel name + three-dot menu, then a small action row when expanded. Test button in header as an icon so it’s visible but not dominant. Samir: Concern: icon-only Test might be unclear for screen readers. Need proper `aria-label` and focus state. Jordan P: +1 on aria. Also keyboard users should be able to expand/collapse via Enter/Space on the header. If it’s accordion, we need `aria-expanded` toggles. Maya R: Copy nit: we currently use "Mute channel" in mocks. Ops asked for "Silence" to match other alerts pages. Can we unify? "Silence" feels a bit jargony though. Liam T: Prefer "Silence" for consistency with the incident flow. But we should add a tooltip: "Silence notifications for X time" to reduce ambiguity. Samir: Accessibility nit: the orange badge color (warning) in the compact header fails 4.5:1 contrast on the dark theme. Either darken or add a subtle outline for contrast. Alex K: Good call. I’ll push an updated swatch. Also thinking: allow drag handle to reorder channels in the panel — saves users from going into settings. Thoughts? Maya R: Reordering is nice, but can we persist order per-project? Otherwise it’s confusing across teams. Jordan P: Persist per-project makes sense. Also add a small undo toast: "Order saved — Undo" for accidental drags. DesignBot: Updated preview deployed to staging: /design/notify/accordion-2026 (preview changeset #452). Liam T: Saw the staging link — animation feels slightly slow. Maybe 180ms for expand, 120ms for collapse. Alex K: Will tune. Also thinking about suppression schedules: current mock places schedule inline under the channel — that expands the accordion a lot. Proposal: move schedule to a side flyout (overlay) launched by "Manage suppression" link in the header. Samir: Flyout helps keep the main list compact. Ensure the flyout is modal and trap focus. Screen reader should read "Suppression schedule for " on open. Maya R: UX flow question: when a user edits a schedule, should we show a preview pill in the header like "Suppressed until 3pm"? I think yes. Alex K: Agreed. Small pill with relative time, hover shows exact range. That also helps in the collapsed view. Jordan P: Microcopy: change "Preview" button label in the test flow to "Preview notification" — less ambiguous for new users. Liam T: Add analytics event for preview click + channel id so we can measure adoption. Samir: Another a11y thing: use visible focus ring on the drag handle and ensure color is customizable via tokens. Alex K: I’ll update the spec. Quick snippet for the aria pattern I’ll add to the design doc: ```html ``` Maya R: Nice. One more: mobile collapse state — we should show only the top 2 channels with a "Show more" to avoid huge screens. Jordan P: And ensure touch targets are >= 44px. Alex K: OK I’ll iterate on that and drop a new preview by EOD. Thanks everyone for quick feedback :rocket:
